ARC VOX vocal processing plugin · by ITMR Audio

Keep your head on the song.

ARC VOX is a vocal-processing plugin by ITMR Audio for artists who know how the vocal should feel. Learn Voice builds a starting point from your performance, while CONTROL and CHARACTER let you steer the result. The chain handles cleanup, pitch correction, de-essing, compression, six-band EQ, color, and space. Open the rack when you want to make the decisions yourself.

learn voice

Build the starting point from your performance.

Play a quiet line and a loud one. Learn Voice listens for 12 seconds, reads your range and dynamics, and sets the chain from that performance instead of dropping in a generic preset.

  • 1LISTENPlay your softest and loudest lines.
  • 2ANALYZEARC VOX reads the 12-second capture.
  • 3READYYour chain starts from your range.

specs

What Arc Vox actually does.

The details below come from the plugin itself—no vague claims and no rounded-up specs.

2macro knobs
7modules in the rack
6parametric EQ bands
27.7ms total latency in Mix
quality

Three quality modes

Switch between Track, Mix and Studio from the footer. Total latency is always shown next to them.

TRACKMIXSTUDIO
compare

A/B and audition

Two settings slots, plus Original against Processed, so you always know what the chain is doing.

AB
gain

Auto LVL

Level matching in the header keeps comparisons honest, so louder never fools you into thinking it's better.

AUTO LVL
tone

Six-band parametric EQ

A full EQ with ±18 dB range inside the chain. Use the mouse wheel for Q, Shift for fine moves and right-click for band controls.

tune

Key or chromatic

Correction and Speed with Natural, Modern and Hard modes, locked to a key or fully chromatic.

interface

Scales to your screen

UI scale at 100, 125 or 150 percent, with a 30 FPS meter refresh. Scaling changes the view, never the sound.

100%125%150%
